title: Privacy Policy
intro: Your privacy is important to us. Please read our policy carefully to understand how we collect, use, and protect your information.
metaDescription: Learn how Pixovo collects, uses, and protects your photos and personal information when you design and order a photo book.

sections.title: Overview
sections.html: This Privacy Policy explains how Pixovo ("we", "us",for "our") collects, uses, stores, and protects your personal information when you use our website and services.

sections.html:

We use your information to:

sections.title: Data Protection
